articulation.label: November
articulation.alt: November: /n/ → /oʊ/ → /v/ → /ɛ/ → /m/ → /b/ → /ɚ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
/o/: Start with a mid-back tongue and round lips.
/ʊ/: Raise the back tongue a little more.
/v/: Upper teeth touch the lower lip; add voice.
/ɛ/: Front tongue; open the jaw a little more.
/m/: Close both lips; air goes through the nose.
/b/: Close lips briefly; release into the next vowel.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.
